title: astragalus macilentus
intro: Astragalus macilentus, commonly known as the "Thin Astragalus" or "Dwarf Milk Vetch", is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include enhancing immune function, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus macilentus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to have immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
